title: Find a nearby rental
caption: Browse the map and filters. Example homes in this demo are fictional.
narration: Welcome to Malapit. Use the map, location search and filters to find nearby rentals. The homes and people shown in this guide are fictional.

title: Advertise a property
caption: Owners use List your place to submit a public listing for review.
narration: To advertise a property, choose List your place. Add its details, location, photos and costs. A listing goes through review before appearing publicly.

title: Add a private unit
caption: My Rentals keeps your private unit, agreed rent and rental dates together.
narration: For an existing rental, open My Rentals and add your unit or room. Record the rent, due day and dates agreed with your renter. This does not publish a listing.

title: Invite your renter
caption: Use their Google sign-in email. Copy and share the invitation link yourself.
narration: Invite the renter using their Google sign in email. Check the unit details first. Copy and share the invitation link yourself. Malapit does not send an email.

title: Renter reviews the invitation
caption: Check the owner, unit, rent and dates before accepting the private connection.
narration: In the renter account, review the invitation. Check the owner, address, rent and rental dates before accepting. This connects the record; it does not sign a lease.

title: Create the monthly bill
caption: Check the covered dates, amount and due date. Partial-month rent is entered manually.
narration: The owner can now create a rent bill. Check its billing month, covered dates, amount and due date. Enter the agreed amount for a partial month yourself.

title: Both accounts see the bill
caption: The renter sees the same private bill and its remaining balance in the records.
narration: The renter sees the same bill in My Rentals. Open it to review the amount, covered period and remaining balance. Money is paid directly to the owner.

title: Report a payment
caption: After paying the owner directly, enter the amount, method, date and reference.
narration: After paying the owner directly, choose Report a payment. Enter the amount, method, date and transaction reference. You can report a partial payment.

title: Wait for owner confirmation
caption: A report stays Awaiting confirmation. Pending amounts do not reduce the balance.
narration: The report is now awaiting confirmation. Its amount is shown separately. Reporting a payment does not mark the bill paid or reduce the confirmed balance.

title: Owner checks receipt
caption: Compare the report with your original cash, bank or wallet records before confirming.
narration: The owner opens the report and checks the original cash, bank or wallet records. Confirm receipt only after checking. If something is wrong, request a correction with a reason.

title: See the remaining balance
caption: Only confirmed amounts reduce the balance. A partial payment leaves the remainder visible.
narration: Once confirmed by the owner, the payment reduces the balance. In this example, three thousand pesos is confirmed and five thousand pesos remains.

title: Record money already received
caption: Owners can also record a payment they have already checked and received.
narration: Owners can record money they have already received, including cash. Check the amount and date, choose the method, and confirm receipt before saving.

title: Paid in the records
caption: The bill shows Paid when owner-confirmed records cover its full amount.
narration: The bill shows Paid when the owner confirmed records cover the full amount. This is a shared record of the owner's confirmation, not a transfer processed by Malapit.

title: Keep the payment history
caption: Both people can review the original amounts, decisions, dates and reasons.
narration: Open Payment history to review who reported, confirmed or corrected a record. The original amounts and decisions remain visible to the original owner and renter.

title: Correct a confirmed record
caption: A reversal needs a reason and keeps the original history. It does not return money.
narration: To correct a confirmed record, the owner uses a reversal and gives a reason. A reversal changes the recorded balance. It does not move or return money.

title: Your records, in one place
caption: Use the monthly overview to track bills, confirmed amounts and remaining balances.
narration: Your rental map, bills and owner confirmed payment records are in one Malapit account. Use the monthly overview to stay organised. Always arrange actual money transfers directly.
